business_problem: indasys needed a high-performance platform for internal AI workloads and commercial customer services, with control over sensitive data and workload locations, flexible private-cloud or on-premises deployment, and capacity that could scale without significant upfront infrastructure investment. Tender preparation and support operations were also time- and resource-intensive.
solution_summary: indasys worked with Lenovo to deploy a modular private-cloud AI platform on Lenovo TruScale Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), scaling capacity as demand grows without significant upfront infrastructure investment. Lenovo ThinkSystem servers, Intel® Xeon® 6 processors, NVIDIA L4 Tensor Core GPUs and Lenovo storage provide local resources and accelerated performance for AI workloads; the platform keeps sensitive data and workloads under local control, with private-cloud hosting in Germany or on-premises options. Lenovo Professional Services supported implementation and established best practices. The platform runs indasys’ internal AI applications and supports customer services offered through BaWü Cloud and Agentum GmbH. AI analytics support tender opportunity evaluation and bid preparation, while in support operations they automate task scheduling and provide real-time visibility into engineer availability. The source does not identify specific AI models or a data-ingestion pipeline.
